messages:
maria (Partnerships): quick sync — IntegratorOne is handing over ~12 marketplace leads from their Q1 push. want to lock ROE + account mapping before we queue a joint announce. propose: Sales owns pipeline follow-ups, SEs own tech validation, Partnerships coordinates announce cadence. who OK?

devin (Sales): thanks — are these net-new or overlaps with existing AEs? need clear ownership rules (existing opp vs new).

maria (Partnerships): mostly net-new. 3 overlaps with active AE touches (past 90d). proposal: if AE has active opp within 90d -> AE retains primary; otherwise integrator-assigned SDR/rep gets primary.

june (Solutions Eng): for tech validation we need mapping CSV with these fields: company, aws_account_id, integrator_lead_id, existing_ae, expected_workload, priority. can you drop that?

maria (Partnerships): dropping CSV to the partnership folder in 5. sample mapping snippet below:
```csv
company,aws_account_id,integrator_lead_id,existing_ae,notes
Acme Corp,123456789012,INT-234,,interested in marketplace gpu SKU
Beta LLC,234567890123,INT-235,AE-Kelvin,contacted AE 2026-02
Delta Inc,345678901234,INT-236,,on-prem evaluation
```

devin (Sales): OK — for overlaps, what's fallback SLA if AE declines within 48h? do we auto-assign back to integrator?

kai (Product): for the joint announce cadence, recommend soft-listing on marketplace + integrator blog the week after first successful POC. also: do not include logos/quotes until legal confirms.

sarah (Legal): correct — need signed logo release + asset checklist. I'll share the template. no logos or press quotes without customer opt-in and release.

announcement-bot: reminder — marketplace push window: 2026-05-12. remember to tag listing as "IntegratorOne + Redwood" for tracking.

maria (Partnerships): action items: 1) Sales validate overlaps (devin) 2) SEs run tech quick-checks (june) 3) Legal gather logos/permissions (sarah) 4) Partnerships submit marketplace package (maria) 5) Product confirm timeline & assets (kai). who owns the live tracking doc?

devin (Sales): i'll own the tracking sheet. will ping affected AEs for a 48h decision window and update ownership column. sharing link: https://tiny.redwood/si-handoff-3311

june (Solutions Eng): i'll start tech-checks once i have contacts and the CSV. @maria can you loop in IntegratorOne eng contact?

maria (Partnerships): looping now — IntegratorOne contact: Priya Sharma <priya@integratorone.com>, ops lead. cc @devin @june.

devin (Sales): noted, i'll reach out to AEs and start outreach to Priya in parallel. :thumbsup:

maria (Partnerships): thanks all. I'll update the partnership folder with the mapping CSV + a checklist (submission, legal release, POC timeline). ping here if timeline needs to slip for any reason.

(reacted with :eyes: by june (Solutions Eng))
